purpose: Manifest of the checkpoints this project expects. NO checkpoint is committed to Git; place the files at the listed locations (or pass --weights) before running anything with pretrained=true.
never_downloaded: This project never downloads weights. Missing XT/S checkpoints are a hard failure unless backbone.pretrained=false is set explicitly.
safe_loading: All backbone checkpoints are loaded with torch.load(path, map_location='cpu', weights_only=True); a failure is never downgraded to weights_only=False.

checkpoints.env_var: OVERLOCK_SOURCE_ROOT points at the official OverLoCK-main checkout
checkpoints.sha256_note: recorded from the local file by checkpoint.sha256_file; re-verify the server copy with scripts/smoke.py M05

checkpoints.note: XT has no local checkpoint; only explicitly random structure tests (backbone.pretrained=false) are run for it.
S has no local checkpoint; only explicitly random structure tests (backbone.pretrained=false) are run for it.

detection_only_keys_allowed_missing.meaning: The classification checkpoint simply does not contain these detection-only parameters, so they keep their initialisation. This is NOT the V1 claim that they were 'unused by the forward pass and therefore absent from state_dict' -- that causal explanation was wrong.
